violations.text: Menu lacks an allergen statement. PIC created one during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by a bag of items stored in sink. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC removed items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
The hand-washing sink in the bathroom was lacking paper towels. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Various items were observed held between 46-61 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed of or moved items to a cooler based on time/temp. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by droppings behind equipment. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the kitchen area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/03/2024
Handwash sink observed in poor repair. Observed leak at plumbing.PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/03/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (kitchen) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions.PIC to remove prior to food preparation New Violation. Correct By: 10/03/2024
The hand-washing sink in the toilet room was lacking signage. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2024
